summary: Freya Bank calls a customer who is 1 to 45 days late on one product to find the customer, check identity, state the debt, get a payment promise where it can, and close the call with the correct outcome.

call_variables.name: customer_id
call_variables.meaning: Pass it to every tool call. (Brief §2; example c_4f2a...)

call_variables.name: first_name
call_variables.meaning: First name of the person to ask for. (Brief §2; example Daniel)

call_variables.name: last_name
call_variables.meaning: Last name of the person to ask for; used with title to address the customer. (Brief §2; example Reyes)

call_variables.name: title
call_variables.meaning: Mr or Ms. Address the customer as title plus last name. (Brief §2)

call_variables.name: now
call_variables.meaning: The current date and time, e.g. 2026-10-14T11:00. All date rules use this, never the real clock. (Brief §2)

stages.what_happens: First sentence: say you are a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank and that the call is recorded. Do not say collections, debt, payment or the product.

Ask "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?". Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name confirms; "Hello", "go ahead" and "who is this" do not. Answer a customer question first (rules 4 and 43); the ask that follows is the second ask. If still unclear after the second ask, close not_reached / unclear.

Do not say why you are calling, say nothing beyond the opening sentence, ask when the customer can be reached. Schedule a callback inside the window, or close as no_callback, wrong_number or deceased. A relative may not answer security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.
stages.may_start_only_after: It is clear that someone other than the customer is on the line

stages.what_happens: Ask two security questions one at a time: first date of birth, then last four digits of the phone number on file. Call verify_identity with each answer (date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD). Three wrong answers in total end the check. Customer declining leads to one explanation, then close not_verified / declined.
Call get_account. Say you are calling from the collections team about a late payment, name the product in words, state the past-due amount and how many days late it is.

Ask for the full past-due amount first and ask "Can you make this payment today?". Handle proposed dates (section 7) and amounts (section 8). A flat refusal or non-answer uses one persuasion attempt (1 in early band, 2 in late band). Handle hardship, already paid, dispute, restructuring request, request for a human.

Read the product, the amount and the date back and ask "Do you confirm?". Call create_promise only after a clear yes. If the customer changes date or amount, re-check and read back again. Say it is recorded only after ok: true, then say the text-message sentence. On failure try once more; on second failure say you could not record it.
stages.may_start_only_after: A date and an amount that pass sections 7 and 8 are agreed

stages.what_happens: Thank the customer and say goodbye, then exactly one close_call with the outcome and, where the table lists one, a reason. It is the last tool call.
stages.may_start_only_after: An outcome is reached under the closing table (rule 46)

not_before.applies_to: Someone other than the customer who answers
not_before.source: Rule 5: "Do not say why you are calling. Say nothing beyond the opening sentence of rule 1."

not_before.source: Rule 10: "A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay."

not_before.forbidden: Asking the identity question again before answering a question the customer asked
not_before.until: The customer's question is answered (rules 4 and 43)
not_before.applies_to: The person on the line before confirmation
not_before.source: Rule 3: "Answer a question from the customer first (rules 4 and 43). The ask that follows is the second ask."

not_before.source: Rule 14: "After three wrong answers, do not state the debt."; rules 16-17

not_before.source: Rule 24: "Ask for the full past-due amount first."; rule 26: "If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once."; rule 27; rule 30

not_before.forbidden: Persuasion attempt 2 (floor amount on the deadline)
not_before.until: Attempt 1 was used and the customer is in the late band (days_late 8 to 45)
not_before.source: Rule 30: "Attempt 2, late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline."

not_before.until: Never, once the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss
not_before.source: Rule 32: "say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt... This rule comes before rules 30 and 41."

not_before.forbidden: Saying "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."

not_before.forbidden: Calling transfer_to_agent with queue general for a request for a human

fixed_sentences.when: Right after the opening sentence, to find out who is on the line
The person says the customer has died; ask nothing else afterwards
fixed_sentences.text: I am sorry for your loss.

fixed_sentences.when: First ask when getting the promise
fixed_sentences.text: Can you make this payment today?

fixed_sentences.when: After reading the product, the amount and the date back

fixed_sentences.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

fixed_sentences.when: Naming the product when stating the debt (product named in words; card digits from the account)

calculations.name: today
calculations.rule: The current date and time come from the call variable now, never the real clock.
calculations.source: §2: "All date rules use this, never the real clock."

calculations.name: business_day
calculations.source: §7: "Business days are Monday to Friday, except Freya Bank holidays"

calculations.name: band
calculations.rule: days_late 1 to 7 = early; days_late 8 to 45 = late.

calculations.name: deadline
calculations.rule: Early band: the 12th business day after today. Late band: the 7th business day after today.

calculations.name: valid_promise_date
calculations.rule: Today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

calculations.name: weekend_or_holiday_date
calculations.rule: If the named day is a weekend day or holiday not after the deadline, offer the next business day. If it is after the deadline, rule 23 applies: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it.

calculations.name: weekday_phrases
calculations.rule: "Next <weekday>" = that weekday in the following calendar week. "This <weekday>" = the one in the current week. "Next Friday" said on a Friday is the Friday of the following week.

calculations.name: attempt_1_date
calculations.rule: The last business day of this week. If today is that day, the last business day of next week.

calculations.name: attempt_1_amount
calculations.rule: The full past-due amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.

calculations.name: attempt_2_offer
calculations.rule: Late band only: the floor amount on the deadline.
calculations.source: Rule 30; rule 26: "Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline."

calculations.name: floor
calculations.rule: minimum_payment for a credit card; instalment_amount for a personal loan or a car loan.

calculations.name: acceptable_amount
calculations.rule: Accept a customer-proposed amount from the floor up to the full past-due amount, both included. Below the floor it cannot be recorded.

calculations.name: callback_window
calculations.rule: Today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than now.

calculations.name: date_of_birth_format
calculations.rule: Send as YYYY-MM-DD whatever way the customer said it. Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year.
calculations.source: Rule 11; openapi verify_identity answer: "the date as YYYY-MM-DD. Callers say dates in words, the agent converts."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent asks "Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?" without getting a valid confirmation
limits.after_limit: If still unclear after the second ask, close as not_reached / unclear. An ask that follows answering a customer question counts as the second ask.
limits.source: Rule 3: "Ask once more. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent asks for another time after the person offers a day or time outside the callback window
limits.after_limit: If the second offered time is also outside the window, do not schedule; close as not_reached / no_callback.
limits.source: Rule 7: "ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule."

limits.what_is_counted: Wrong security answers in total, whichever question they were on. A day_month_swapped hint retry and an unreadable value rejected with ok=false do not count. The response also carries wrong_answers_left.
limits.after_limit: The check ends. Do not state the debt. Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch. Close as not_verified / failed.
limits.source: Rule 12: "Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on."; rule 14; rule 13; openapi verify_identity

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent explains that the questions protect the customer's account
limits.after_limit: If the customer still declines, close as not_verified / declined.
limits.source: Rule 15: "explain once that the questions protect their account. If they still decline, close as `not_verified` / `declined`."

limits.what_is_counted: Customer refusals to answer the security questions, including asking what the call is about instead of answering
limits.after_limit: The second refusal or second such question closes the call as not_verified / declined.
limits.source: Rule 15: "Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. A second refusal or a second such question closes the call."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent asks for the exact day after a vague period ("next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes")
limits.after_limit: If the customer still gives no exact day, propose the deadline.
limits.source: Rule 21: "ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent offers the floor after the customer says the full amount is too much (saying the rest stays overdue)
limits.after_limit: If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30). Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent offers the floor after the customer proposes an amount below the floor
limits.after_limit: If the customer does not accept the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
limits.source: Rule 27: "Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once."

limits.what_is_counted: Persuasion attempts; each flat refusal or non-answer uses one
limits.n_depends_on: days_late 1 to 7 (early band): n = 1; days_late 8 to 45 (late band): n = 2
limits.after_limit: Stop. Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. Close as no_promise / refused.
limits.source: Rule 18 table "Persuasion attempts"; rule 30: "A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt."; rule 31

limits.what_is_counted: Times an offer the customer already refused may be made
limits.after_limit: The same refused offer is not made again.
limits.source: Rule 31: "Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused."

limits.what_is_counted: Short sentences of sympathy after the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss
limits.after_limit: Make no persuasion attempt; offer to connect them with the customer support team.
limits.source: Rule 32: "say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt."

limits.after_limit: The recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. If the customer asks, say they can change it in the mobile app.
limits.source: Rule 36: "One promise per product."; openapi /create_promise: "One per product."

limits.what_is_counted: Failed create_promise calls for the confirmed promise (the first failure is followed by one more try)
limits.after_limit: After the second failure, say you could not record it and close as no_promise / service_error.
limits.source: Rule 37: "If it fails, try once more. If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the agent asks whether it can help first when the customer requests a human
limits.after_limit: If the customer insists, call transfer_to_agent with queue general and close as transferred / human.
limits.source: Rule 42: "ask once whether you can help first."

limits.what_is_counted: Times the customer says they do not want to talk
limits.after_limit: On the second time, close as no_promise / refused; before identity is verified, close as not_verified / declined.
limits.source: Rule 45: "If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk, close as `no_promise` / `refused`. Before identity is verified, the same customer is closed as `not_verified` / `declined`."

limits.after_limit: No further tool call; nothing is accepted after it.
limits.source: Rule 46: "Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`... It is the last tool call."; openapi /close_call

endings.when: At least one promise was recorded
endings.say_before: "You will receive a text message confirming this promise." (rule 38), then thank the customer and say goodbye (rule 47)
endings.source: Rule 46 table: "`promise` | none | at least one promise was recorded"

endings.when: Customer says "I already paid" (a payment of this past-due amount)
endings.say_before: Say that payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Customer asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments; transfer_to_agent called with queue restructuring
endings.say_before: Do not describe a plan; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Customer asks for a human, agent asked once whether it can help first, customer insists; transfer_to_agent called with queue general (before or after verification)
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss and accepts the offer of the customer support team; transfer_to_agent called with queue support
endings.say_before: One short sentence of sympathy, the support offer; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: A transfer follows a recorded promise

fields.reason: that transfer's reason (restructuring, human or support)

endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye
endings.source: §12: "If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as `transferred` with that transfer's reason."

endings.when: Persuasion attempts are used up, or the customer (after verification) says twice that they do not want to talk
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss and declines the support transfer (and names no date or amount themselves)
endings.say_before: One short sentence of sympathy; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: "This debt is not mine", "I never had this product", or a claim the product was closed or paid off in the past
endings.say_before: Do not argue, take no promise; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: create_promise fails, is tried once more and fails again
endings.say_before: Say you could not record it; thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Three wrong security answers in total
endings.say_before: Do not state the debt. Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch; thank and say goodbye

endings.when: Customer still declines the security questions after one explanation (second refusal or second "what is this about" question), or says twice before verification that they do not want to talk
endings.say_before: Thank the customer and say goodbye

endings.when: Someone else answers and a callback inside the window was booked with schedule_callback
endings.say_before: Nothing about the reason for the call; thank and say goodbye

endings.when: The person's offered time is outside the window and, after one ask for another time, the next one is also outside it
endings.say_before: Do not schedule; thank and say goodbye

endings.when: The person says the number does not belong to the customer
The person says the customer has died
endings.say_before: "I am sorry for your loss." Ask nothing else.

endings.when: Who is on the line is still unclear after the second ask

tool_failures.rule: Say the promise is recorded only after ok: true. If it fails, try once more. If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as no_promise / service_error.
An unreadable date_of_birth value is rejected with ok=false and is not counted as a wrong answer.
tool_failures.source: openapi verify_identity answer description; rule 11: "The service rejects anything it cannot read as a date."

tool_failures.rule: hint: "day_month_swapped" means day and month were given the other way round; ask the customer to say the month as a word. That retry does not count as a wrong answer.
Refused until both questions are passed.

tool_failures.tool: all tools (verify_identity, get_account, create_promise, add_note, schedule_callback, transfer_to_agent, close_call)
tool_failures.rule: `ok` is false when the action was not carried out. On HTTP 500 the service failed, nothing was recorded, and the call may be repeated.
tool_failures.source: openapi responses: "`ok` is false when the action was not carried out."; "The service failed. Nothing was recorded. The call may be repeated."

tool_failures.rule: The service does not enforce the brief: it records a promise on a holiday or past the deadline without complaint. Following the brief is the agent's job.
Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.

not_stated: What to do when verify_identity, get_account, schedule_callback, transfer_to_agent or close_call fails (ok=false or HTTP 500); only create_promise has a failure rule, and the API only says a 500 call 'may be repeated' with no retry count.
Whether an HTTP 500 from create_promise counts as a 'fail' under rule 37 in the same way as ok: false.
What `verified` contains on a response that carries hint day_month_swapped or ok=false, and whether the agent should count wrong answers itself or rely on wrong_answers_left.
How many day_month_swapped retries or unreadable-date retries are allowed.
The exact wording of the opening sentence, the thank-you and goodbye, the robot/AI answer, the sympathy sentence and the security-question explanation.
Freya Bank's customer service number for the 'Is this a scam?' answer (rule 43).
What to do if get_account returns more than one product, or no product (the response is an array; the brief covers one product).
What to do if days_late is outside 1 to 45.
Currency and how amounts are to be spoken.
What to do when the person who answers gives no time at all, or does not know when the customer can be reached.
Time zone of `now` and of the callback window.
How 'Can you make this payment today?' works when today is not a business day (rule 19 requires a business day).
What 'the last business day of this week' is when the call is made on a weekend, or when that day has already passed.
Whether rules 39, 40 and 41 apply before identity is verified (only rules 42 and 45 state pre-verification behaviour).
The outcome for silence, voicemail, a dropped call or a caller who hangs up.
What to close as if transfer_to_agent fails.
Whether refusing the next business day offered under rule 20 is a flat refusal.
Whether the customer saying the full amount is too much (rule 26) itself uses a persuasion attempt.
What the agent says or does after a promise is recorded if the customer raises nothing else, beyond the text-message sentence and the goodbye.
The `reason` value to send for outcomes promise and paid (the table says none; the API marks reason as not required for them).
